script.cite: BK4 printed p.70 step 1 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.76; stated for the 14-wire circuit before the carry wires are added
script.quote: Turn power ON. Notice that both relays 5 and 6 are OFF.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.70 step 2 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.76; stated for the 14-wire circuit before the carry wires are added
script.quote: Push and release pushbutton 6. Notice that both relays 5 and 6 are now ON.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.70 step 3 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.76; stated for the 14-wire circuit before the carry wires are added
script.quote: Push pushbutton 6, but do not release. Notice that relay 5 is OFF; relay 6 is ON.

note: The page says light 4 indicates carry but prints no absolute light-4 value; this fixture does not invent one. Modeled release-path quantization knife edge: under REF-A, relay 5 drops out at tick t=1498 with 17,789 uA against its 17,793-uA threshold, a 4-uA margin. This carve-out does not attribute SDC's documented physical counter marginality to L_coil_uh or identify its physical cause.
